scope: Round 2: frozen held-out prediction export and independent reconstruction of the existing six metric rows. This is a distinct implementation scope on the same date as round 1, not elapsed-time surveillance.
inclusion_criteria: Primary molecular evaluation studies that clarify why sample identity, partition membership, and metric definition matter to reuse
Official versioned definitions for the existing regression metrics and train/test separation
exclusion_criteria: New model architecture or biological application without a consequence for the export/verification contract
General surveys rather than needed primary evidence
New endpoints, experiments, model-selection schemes, and claims requiring changed scientific results
